title: TableVista: Benchmarking Multimodal Table Reasoning under Visual and Structural Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2605.05955v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce TableVista, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating foundation models in multimodal table reasoning under visual and structural complexity. TableVista consists of 3,000 high-quality table reasoning problems, where each instance is expanded into 10 distinct visual variants through our multi-style rendering and transformation pipeline. This process encompasses diverse scenario styles, robustness perturbations, and vision-only configurations, culminating in 30,000 multimodal samples for a multi-dimensional evaluation. We conduct an extensive evaluation of 29 state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary foundation models on TableVista. translated_title: TableVista：视觉与结构复杂性下的多模态表格推理基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TableVista，一个用于评估基础模型在视觉和结构复杂性条件下多模态表格推理能力的综合性基准。TableVista包含3,000个高质量的表格推理问题，其中每个实例通过我们的多风格渲染与转换流水线扩展为10个不同的视觉变体。这一过程涵盖了多样化的场景风格、鲁棒性扰动以及纯视觉配置，最终形成30,000个多模态样本，用于多维度评估。我们对29个最先进的开源和专有基础模型在TableVista上进行了广泛评估。通过全面的定量与定性分析，我们发现尽管被评估的模型在各种渲染风格下基本保持稳定，但它们在复杂结构布局和纯视觉设置下表现出明显的性能下降，这表明当前模型难以应对视觉与结构复杂性带来的挑战。
tldr: TableVista是一个包含3,000个表格问题、30,000个多模态样本的综合基准，通过评估29个前沿模型揭示了当前基础模型虽能稳定应对多样渲染风格，但在复杂结构布局和纯视觉设置下存在显著的性能下降。
en_tdlr: TableVista is a comprehensive benchmark of 3,000 table reasoning problems expanded into 30,000 multimodal samples, which reveals through evaluation of 29 frontier models that current foundation models remain stable across diverse rendering styles but suffer pronounced performance degradation on complex structural layouts and vision-only settings.
